scripts.generate: npm run build:tools && tsx packages/compiler/src/cli.ts packages/css/src/schema.ts && tsx packages/compiler/src/cli.ts packages/js/src/schema.ts && tsx packages/compiler/src/cli.ts packages/json/src/schema.ts
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.conformance:fetch: npm run fetch -w @parser2/css && npm run fetch -w @parser2/js
scripts.test:js:conformance: npm run generate && npm run test:conformance -w @parser2/js
scripts.test:css:conformance: npm run generate && npm run test:conformance -w @parser2/css
scripts.baseline: npm run baseline -w @parser2/css && npm run baseline -w @parser2/js && npm run baseline -w @parser2/json
scripts.gate: npm run gate -w @parser2/css && npm run gate -w @parser2/js && npm run gate -w @parser2/json
